Runs unit tests and writes each test log to LOG_PATH.

# Purpose
This script runs a set of supplemental unit tests after the automatic test suite and writes each test output to a separate log file under `$LOG_PATH`. It requires `OBJDIR` and `MACHINE`, sets `FD_LOG_PATH` to `-`, and exports `LLVM_PROFILE_FILE` so the test programs use the expected logging and coverage settings. The script runs control, workspace, allocation, pod, tango, shared-memory helper, and multi-tile tests, then performs an IPC test sequence and records `pass` or `FAIL` in `$LOG_PATH/ipc`. Several additional tests are present but commented out because they need extra system resources or input files, and the script ends by printing the last non-log lines from each log file for quick review.
